mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.supplier_id, p.material_id, p.price, p.tax_rate, p.lead_days, p.min_qty, p.is_default, p.remark, p.valid_from, p.valid_to, p.create_time, p.update_time, s.code AS supplier_code, s.name AS supplier_name, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit FROM scm_supplier_price p JOIN scm_supplier s ON s.id = p.supplier_id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = p.material_id
mapper.select: WHERE p.is_default = 1 AND s.status = 1 AND (p.valid_from IS NULL OR p.valid_from <= CURRENT_DATE) AND (p.valid_to IS NULL OR p.valid_to >= CURRENT_DATE) AND p.material_id IN #{id}

SELECT d.biz_date AS "bizDate", d.doc_no AS "docNo", d.partner_id AS "supplierId", s.name AS "supplierName", i.material_id AS "materialId", i.qty AS "qty", i.price AS "price", i.tax_rate AS "taxRate" FROM scm_trade_doc_item i JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.id = i.doc_id JOIN scm_supplier s ON s.id = d.partner_id WHERE d.kind = 'PURCHASE_IN' AND i.material_id = #{materialId} AND d.partner_id = #{supplierId} ORDER BY d.biz_date DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT 100
